so_what: Nico Collins' ~2-game absence is the biggest full-PPR swing on the board: a 23.8%-target-share WR out while his owner also navigates a shaky backup QB room.

The Saints backfield split cuts differently in full PPR -- Kamara's receiving role (6 targets in his debut) makes him the higher-value half of the Etienne/Kamara/Donaldson committee here despite Etienne's raw snap lead.

Xavier Hutchinson (HOU) is a confirmed, news-grounded target-share riser directly tied to the Nico Collins injury -- worth bidding aggressively given this league's full-PPR math, full detail in this week's waivers.
This is the deepest, thinnest-wire league of the three (210 rostered) -- Cade Otton and Michael Mayer both show real sustained TE usage worth grabbing before a rival does.
Week 3 opens with a short-week Thursday game (Packers at Falcons) and closes with the Bears hosting the Eagles Monday night, the game most likely to resolve the Caleb Williams hamstring question.
